name: SS Ashtanga Yoga (Sandi Rakhimbayeva, Almaty)
reason: Not a school: the listed site sandisatori.com (robots.txt allows us) is her personal lifestyle site (life, beauty, movement, shop), and her November schedule holds Mysore classes in rented rooms (a hall on Zharokova Street and a ballet studio, where payment goes to the studio) plus Zoom sessions, not a named shala with a fixed home. Her about page also frames her yoga nidra work around trauma therapy and conditions (PTSD, depression, insomnia). Could suit an individual listing later under the health rule, but not as a School.
